footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Compass Diversified: includes a $945K income tax benefit, $2.9M from other items, net, $67.3M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 4.8% to $1.9B in 2025. Gross margin was 43.5%, versus 42.0% a year earlier, and operating income was $11.1M, up from a $14.9M loss.
The net loss widened to $226M, or −$3.59 per share, from $209M. Operating cash flow was −$6.8M and free cash flow −$51.1M, versus −$208M.
watch: Net income includes a $945K tax benefit.
sources: Compass Diversified Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
